title: Jesus raises a Widow’s Son Jesus raises
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells Luke 7:11-16: at Nain Jesus meets the funeral of a widow's only son, his heart goes out to her, he touches the coffin, says "Young man, get up", gives him back to his mother, and the people praise God; Jesus has power over death (John 11:25).
representations: a funeral procession drawn at a town gate
a compare chart: Jairus' daughter and the widow's son
steps: Who had died and who was crying?
What did Jesus do and say?
contexts: comforting a classmate who has lost a relative
visiting a widow in the church

board.do: Draw a crowd carrying a coffin out of a town gate.
Wait for the child to say her only son.

misconceptions.ask: Who did Jesus raise at Nain?
misconceptions.repair: Make two columns: Nain and Jairus.

misconceptions.ask: Why did Jesus raise the widow's son?
Who had died in the story of the widow at Nain?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 7:12: "the only son of his mother, and she was a widow".

listen_for: A long prayer for the family
misconceptions.ask: What did Jesus say to the dead young man (Luke 7:14)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 7:14 aloud. Jesus touched the coffin and spoke a few words with power.

checks.question: In which town did Jesus raise the widow's son?
Why did Jesus raise the young man?
checks.answer: He had compassion on the widow
